from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, subprocess, time

E = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W = E.parent/'rog5-review-correctness-20260912-r1'
T = E/'active-r2'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=W)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['podman', 'ps', '-q']).strip()
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=W, text=True).strip()
tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], cwd=W, text=True).strip()
active = json.loads((T/'active-result.json').read_text())
assert active['exit_status'] == 0 and active['source_commit'] == head and active['source_tree'] == tree
assert head == '4beee9a27b2136c01a7aab400e97d3d9a29c07b5'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cache', W/'scripts/host/prepare-qemu-linker-cache.py')
cache = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(cache)
bound = json.loads((E.parent/'rog5-vm-startup-stall-20260919-r1/hwdb-prepared/result.json').read_text())
runtime, view, metadata = cache.bound_runtime(Path(bound['tree']['path']), Path(bound['materialization']['path']), Path(bound['view_receipt']['path']))
assert metadata == bound['view_metadata_sha256']
probe = E.parent/'rog5-icon-startup-20260919-r1/build-r1/settings-sync-diagnostic.so'
assert cache.digest(probe) == '7a3cac369e1bd0d35b3af53b4b6c91ecbd6d199efd669fddeb7a871eb2edef38'
assert (W/'tools/qemu-virtio-drm/settings-sync-diagnostic.c').read_bytes() == (probe.parent/'settings-sync-diagnostic.c').read_bytes()
cmd = json.loads((E/'command.json').read_text())
old = json.loads((E.parent/'rog5-device-readiness-20260919-r1/command.json').read_text())
expected = old.copy()
expected[expected.index('--output')+1] = str(E/'vm-r1')
assert expected[-2:] == ['--tcg-thread', 'single']
assert cmd == expected
assert cmd[cmd.index('--runtime-view')+1] == str(view)
prior_result_path = E.parent/'rog5-device-readiness-20260919-r1/vm-r1/result.json'
prior_result = json.loads(prior_result_path.read_text())
changed_path = W/'tools/qemu-virtio-drm/logind-session.sh'
retained_inputs = {}
for path, info in prior_result['inputs'].items():
    if Path(path) == changed_path:
        original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', prior_result['source']['commit']+':tools/qemu-virtio-drm/logind-session.sh'], cwd=W)
        assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() == info['sha256']
        assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', 'b438b900', '--', 'tools/qemu-virtio-drm/logind-session.sh'], cwd=W)
    else:
        assert cache.digest(path) == info['sha256'], path
        retained_inputs[path] = info['sha256']
record = dict(source_commit=head, source_tree=tree, command=cmd,
              authority='none; generic ARM64 VM only', physical='NOT RUN',
              delta='Same single-TCG close-only command, with fresh output. Only guest device-readiness diagnostics change; one eight-second wait and original result remain; same SMP, limits, retained inputs and release probe. No hwdb cache integration.',
              status='FAIL', active_test=cache.identity(T/'active-result.json'),
              script=cache.identity(Path(__file__)))
record.update(prior_result=cache.identity(prior_result_path), unchanged_input_hashes=retained_inputs,
              intentional_guest_readiness_change=dict(before=prior_result['inputs'][str(changed_path)], after=cache.identity(changed_path)))
with (E/'started.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, indent=2)
started = time.monotonic()
try:
    with (E/'command.log').open('x') as log:
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=W, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    record.update(exit_status=result.returncode, status='PASS' if result.returncode == 0 else 'FAIL')
finally:
    record['seconds'] = time.monotonic()-started
    try:
        assert cache.verify_tree(runtime, Path(bound['tree']['path']), view) == metadata
        record['runtime_bytes_and_metadata_unchanged'] = True
        result = json.loads((E/'vm-r1/result.json').read_text())
        for info in result['inputs'].values():
            assert cache.digest(info['path']) == info['sha256'], info['path']
        record['input_hashes_unchanged'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        record.update(status='FAIL', verification_error=f'{type(error).__name__}: {error}')
    with (E/'terminal.json').open('x') as f:
        json.dump(record, f, indent=2)
print(json.dumps(record))
raise SystemExit(record['status'] != 'PASS')

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
E=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def identity(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        digest=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
    return dict(path=str(path),sha256=digest,bytes=path.stat().st_size)

terminal=json.loads((E/'terminal.json').read_text())
result=json.loads((E/'vm-r1/result.json').read_text())
serial=(E/'vm-r1/serial.log').read_text(errors='replace')
clean=re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]','',serial)
app_path=E/'vm-r1/observe/apps.log'
apps=app_path.read_text(errors='replace') if app_path.exists() else ''
qemu=[step for step in result['steps'] if 'qemu-system-aarch64' in step['command']]
stages=[]
for line in apps.splitlines():
    match=re.search(r'ROG5_SETTINGS_SYNC phase=(.*?) pid=(\d+) clock=CLOCK_MONOTONIC seconds=([0-9.]+)',line)
    if match:
        stages.append(dict(phase=match[1],pid=int(match[2]),seconds=float(match[3]),line=line))
summary=dict(status=result['status'],wrapper_status=terminal['status'],source=result['source'],error=result.get('error'),qemu_steps=qemu,
    rcu_stall_reports=serial.count('rcu: INFO: rcu_sched detected stalls'),normal_poweroff='reboot: Power down' in serial,
    app_release_stages=stages,client_exits=re.findall(r'OBSERVE launcher app=(\w+) exit=(\d+)',apps),observation=result.get('apps_observation',{}),
    rendering=result.get('rendering',{'status':'NOT RUN','reason':'runner did not reach rendering qualification'}),
    result=identity(E/'vm-r1/result.json'),terminal=identity(E/'terminal.json'),serial=identity(E/'vm-r1/serial.log'),
    apps=identity(app_path) if app_path.exists() else None,authority='none; VM evidence, no phone qualification')
summary['service_snapshots']=re.findall(r'OBSERVE service-snapshot phase=begin.*?OBSERVE service-snapshot phase=end status=\d+',clean,re.S)
summary['device_readiness_lines']=[line for line in clean.splitlines() if 'OBSERVE device-readiness' in line]
summary['service_stages']=[line for line in clean.splitlines() if 'OBSERVE stage=service-' in line or 'OBSERVE service-clock' in line]
summary['failure_and_cleanup_lines']=[dict(normalized_line=i,text=line) for i,line in enumerate(clean.splitlines(),1) if any(x in line for x in ['FAIL ','failed with result','Failed unmounting','reboot: Power down','Timed out'])]
summary['pam_lines']=[line for line in clean.splitlines() if 'pam_unix' in line or 'PAM session' in line]
(E/'analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:summary[k] for k in ['status','wrapper_status','error','rcu_stall_reports','normal_poweroff','device_readiness_lines','service_stages','client_exits','app_release_stages']},indent=2))

records=[]
for match in re.finditer(r'DIAGNOSTIC_DEVICE_(WAIT|SNAPSHOT) status=(\d+) bytes=(\d+) truncated=([01]) hex=([0-9a-f]*)',clean):
    kind,status,size,truncated,hex_data=match.groups()
    data=bytes.fromhex(hex_data)
    row=dict(kind=kind,status=int(status),bytes=int(size),truncated=bool(int(truncated)),complete=len(data)==int(size),text=data.decode(errors='replace'))
    records.append(row)
    (E/(kind.lower()+'-decoded.log')).write_bytes(data)
summary['device_diagnostics']=records
(E/'analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(records,indent=2))

summary['denial_session_lines']=[line for line in clean.splitlines() if 'KMS session complete' in line or 'KMS teardown happened' in line or 'KMS hold complete' in line]
summary['user_service_journal']=[line for line in clean.splitlines() if 'systemd[501]:' in line and any(word in line for word in ['Starting ', 'Started ', 'Stopping ', 'Stopped '])]
summary['rendering_qualification']=summary.pop('rendering')
summary['rendering_observation']='Denial terminal counters: raster_frames=4, output_page_flips=4, delivered_vsyncs=6; no app mapping or session qualification'
(E/'analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
